checks.observation: The driver requires fresh output directories, builds inherited modules with only the fresh base and package paths, then passes that base to the new-module replay. All 100 inherited and 14 new receipts record stable sources and exit zero; the child lists 66 passing roots within the axiom allowlist. Its reusable cache wording does not negate the outer input binding. The manuscript properly limits the rebuild to the root-reachable project closure and retains Lean, mathlib, third-party caches, and same-controller limitations.
